'''Ortis''' is a Squadman of the [[Winged Guards]] of [[Mayene]]. 

== Appearance ==
He has a burn on one cheek and a scar at the corner of his mouth. He is in his middle years.

== Activities ==
While in [[Ghealdan]] he reports on a group of [[Dragonsworn]] murdering innocent people.
